subject: Byte-identity PROVEN on darwin — preflight passes end to end on the Mac for the first time since #234
body:
Your registry-precedence fix is confirmed on the platform that broke it twice.

MEASURED at 91a1bfc, clean tree, node scripts/preflight.mjs:

  CycloneDX SBOM committed in sync ... ok
  Preflight PASSED - everything it runs is green.

That is the test you handed me and it holds. Regeneration on darwin now reproduces the committed SBOM byte for byte: all 7 previously-divergent components (5 linux-x64 + both fsevents) carry the registry basis property identically, because the committed registry is consulted first for every npm purl and only unregistered purls read an installed manifest. The gate no longer encodes which machine generated it.

Worth recording what it took, because the shape repeats: the first fix corrected the DATA (five missing licences) and the gate still failed, on a field recording HOW each licence was obtained. Fixing the data made the second defect visible — a missing licence fails louder than a differing property, so the property mismatch could not surface until the values agreed. Your second fix corrected the PRECEDENCE, which is the layer that actually determines platform-invariance. Two rounds, and only the second one could have been found from the first.

Your emergent property is the durable part: a platform binary that is neither installed nor registered now fails licence-policy as an unnamed unknown, so the gate self-enforces platform independence from here. Nothing needs to remember this rule.

ALSO DELIVERED, 95c682c: the telemetry lane's first run anywhere passed here (16s, signalgrid_up traversed api /metrics -> collector -> prometheus via the Prometheus query API), both registry halves flipped with deployedEvidence, gate green at 48 entries / 6 deployed-in-lab. One correction: 2026-08-22-source-independence-queue lists live-telemetry as 'still owed'. It was not owed — it passed on 2026-08-21 and sat undelivered on my side. My lag, not a missed run; the request's item (1) is closed by that commit.

Taking the source-independence queue next: live-fleet now, then lane-mail on what sim-operations.mjs is missing for the Headwind CE + Fleet parity session and the GLPI bring-up.
